notes: The Companion is written only as «أبيه» (the father of Sulayman): a relation link, not completed
«المعنى» is an editor's gloss and «واحد» is the compiler's note on the three names' one text: neither is a link
«وقد رواه شعبة عن علقمة بن مرثد أيضا» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group
